assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: image-only next-page navigation button in a children's storybook reader. Use the attached existing Heartsping asset as the exact character basis. Preserve her pink face and body, magenta eyes, curled pink pigtails with heart accessories, collar, chest emblem, and polished soft 3D toy appearance. Do not invent different hair, clothing or a crown. Pose: character shown prominently from waist up on the left, looking toward and happily presenting a very large clear right-pointing arrow on the right. The arrow is a simple thick glossy pink arrow with a gold outline, occupying about half the icon, with an unmistakable right-facing arrowhead. A small open storybook is tucked below the character's hands. Keep the silhouette simple and readable at 64px; minimal detail, no scenery. Square composition with all character and arrow inside frame, little unused padding. Truly transparent background. No text, letters, numbers, watermark, surrounding button rectangle or additional characters. This image will also be mirrored in CSS for the previous-page button; keep the arrow perfectly horizontal.
